escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: A terminal result-only child can be followed by a material source or test commit, leaving an older certificate apparently present but no longer certifying the current candidate.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the current candidate parent and changed paths with the certified material head and result-only allowlist.
literal_case.expected: Any material write after terminal publication activates post-write refreeze and invalidates reuse of the prior certificate.
literal_case.observed: The current material candidate 1a0fe9b106e9c98ae7684296a427e51f890975f6 follows the old terminal child and is treated as material; a fresh refreeze is required and prepared.

prevention_change.description: Preserve the post-write-refreeze latch and do not reuse a certificate whose material SHA predates a material write.

detection_change.description: Classify stale parent/path lineage before publication and require a new result-only child directly on the refrozen material SHA.
